messages:
deploy-bot: Starting staging deploy
Environment: staging
Tag: v2.4.18-rc2
Commit: c7a3f9d
Initiator: jen
Estimated time to healthy: ~10m

jen (release-eng): kicking this off — will pin traffic at 10% canary then ramp if green :rocket:

mike (runtime): heads-up: this build includes the new KV cache opt. keep an eye on mem usage during canary

deploy-bot: Canary routed 10% to instance-group canary-2
Health checks: passing (liveness: ok, readiness: ok)

alice (qa): running smoke suite now: 6 quick prompts. posting results in 3

alice (qa): smoke results: 5/6 green, one reranker latency spike (~480ms) on prompt #3 but correctness looks ok

kevin (sre): saw a transient 503s on canary-2 at 2:13:22 — small blip, autoscaler scaled a pod and route recovered. keeping an eye.

sara (oncall): let's hold ramp until we confirm no more 503s. can we pin traffic back to baseline if it repeats? @deploy-bot

jen (release-eng): agree with holding. if we see >2 errors in 5m we rollback to tag v2.4.17

deploy-bot: Received override request: continue_ramp=true from jen
Manual approval required: commit c7a3f9d passes canary policy? waiting for explicit confirmation.

mike (runtime): I pushed a quick patch to connection pool timeout in staging config — should reduce 503s. patch id: cfg-2026-03-20-1
Command to view: `kubectl -n staging get cm runtime-config -o yaml`

alice (qa): reran smoke after patch: 6/6 green, no latency spike observed

kevin (sre): monitoring window 5m after patch finished — no new 503s. looks stable.

jen (release-eng): approve continue_ramp. rolling to 50% now. tagging rollout note: "canary patch for pool timeout"

deploy-bot: Traffic shifted to 50% canary. Health checks: passing. Autoscaler stable.

deploy-bot: Traffic shifted to 100% staging
Completion: deploy finished
Tag: v2.4.18-rc2
Commit: c7a3f9d
Duration: 7m27s
Artifacts: https://artifacts.redwood.ai/builds/2026/1809876543
Release notes draft: https://docs.redwood.ai/release-notes/drafts/v2.4.18

jen (release-eng): thanks team. will publish release note and start the Dedicated roll when we greenlight tomorrow.

sara (oncall): logging incident blip in postmortem if it reappears, but marking this as resolved for now :white_check_mark:

kevin (sre): adding a quick alert tweak to reduce noise — lowering sensitivity for that particular metric by 10% in staging-only scope

deploy-bot: Post-deploy hooks executed: canary-metrics-check, smoke-eval, alert-tuning

jen (release-eng): moving this thread to archive. good run, everyone :tada:
